etapas.texto: An introduction to the farm and to the rural community of Colonia Osimani and Llerena.
How oranges are grown, the varieties, the daily work and the history of citrus farming in Salto.
A hands-on moment: you turn the fruit into juice yourself.
Marmalades, cakes and other treats, plus products from local makers.
Patricia Real, who runs the farm, shares its story, followed by a group conversation and a short survey.

modalidades.resumen: At the height of the harvest: walk the orange grove, get to know the trees and their fruit, pick oranges when conditions allow and squeeze your own juice.
modalidades.foto: Manos tomando una naranja madura del árbol, hora dorada, primer plano, luz lateral

modalidades.resumen: Outside the harvest, the walk focuses on the life cycle of the orange tree, its care and its history. Tasting and juice-making use fruit from local growers.
modalidades.foto: Filas de naranjos verdes al atardecer, plano general, luz rasante

modalidades.resumen: For students aged 11 to 15: science, geography, history, economics and the environment, learned on a working farm.
modalidades.foto: Grupo de estudiantes escuchando a la encargada entre los naranjos, plano medio, mañana
